section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: CONTINUED FROM PREVIOUS PAGE

content.question: INSPECT CLUTCH SWITCH CIRCUIT (M/T)
content.test: Is there continuity between terminal 11 and body ground with clutch pedal returned?

items: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 11 of computer and terminal 3 of clutch switch.

content.question: INSPECT NEUTRAL START SWITCH CIRCUIT (A/T)
content.test: Is there battery voltage between terminal 11 and body ground when shifting except to "N" range?

items: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 11 of computer and terminal 3 of neutral start switch.

content.question: INSPECT PARKING BRAKE SWITCH CIRCUIT
content.test: Is there battery voltage between terminal 12 and body ground with parking brake lever returned?

items: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 12 of computer and terminal 1 parking brake switch.

content.question: INSPECT SPEED SENSOR CIRCUIT
content.test: Disconnect connector from combination meter. Is there continuity between terminal C-7 (analog meter) or A-12 (digital meter) of wire harness side connector and terminal 6 of computer?

items: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal C-7 (analog meter) or A-12 (digital meter) of combination meter and terminal 6 of computer.

content.question: Disconnect connector from combination meter. Is there continuity between terminal 6 and body ground?

items: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 6 of computer and terminal 20 of combination meter.

content.question: INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
content.test: Disconnect connector from combination meter. Is there continuity between terminal C-6 (analog meter) or A-10 (digital meter) of wire harness side connector and body ground?

items: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal C-6 (analog meter) or A-10 (digital meter) and body ground.

content.question: INSPECT SPEED SENSOR OPERATION
content.test: Is speed sensor operation normal? (See page BE-83)
